player_prompt.intro:
Yin e jiäk Player {player_id} në run {num_rounds}-de IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Run kɔɔr, gɛɛs nam kɛɛn {min_guess} ku {max_guess}.
Gɛɛs kɔɔr kɔɔr, target e (2/3)x(gɛɛs kɔɔr kɔɔr),
ku raan döŋ gɛɛs e ciɛŋ target e win run kɔɔr.
Dhɔ̈l yä gɛɛs në format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: /Ci̱kɛ lät; läri kɛ ɣöö bi̱ luɔtdiɛn jɔɔc ɛ la [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɛmɛt kekë cieŋ kuɛr ë bë̈̈t ë̈̈t ë̈̈t ë̈̈t thïn {min_guess} nä̈k ë̈̈t ë̈̈t thïn {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Wëër ë 0 acë̈̈t ë̈̈t ë̈̈t thïn {guess0}; Wëër ë 1 acë̈̈t ë̈̈t ë̈̈t thïn {guess1}. Thïn, Target eë̈t ë̈̈t ë̈̈t thïn {target}.
message.round_draw: Kä cu rɔɔdɛ la mi̱ /ci̱ te thi̱n.
message.round_win: Ji̱ ŋarä {winner} ci̱kɛ buɔ̱n ɛ wɔ̱!

outcome.p0_wins: Ɛn ŋar ɛ 0 cɛ run ti̱ ŋuan tiam.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɛn ram in nhiam cɛ ti̱ ŋuan tiam.
outcome.draw: Kɛn ŋar diaal ɛ mi̱ caa mat.
